body:
## Why

`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` reports **23 of 24 pages stale** — every page whose `covers:`
list names a file that track A moved. The drift is real but it is not per-card sloppiness: #311 alone
touched `src/board.js`, `src/dispatch.js`, `src/store/*`, `src/forge.js`, `src/init.js`, `src/doctor.js`
and `src/cli.js`, which is most of the `covers:` surface of the whole wiki. Refreshing page-by-page
inside each track card would have meant seven cards each rewriting the same eight pages against a
codebase still moving under them.

**Why it waits for TypeScript.** #305 renames every `src/*.js` to `src/*.ts`. Every `covers:` entry in
every page is a `path` plus a `sha`, so a refresh done before #305 is invalidated by #305 in full — the
paths stop resolving, not just the shas. One refresh after the rename costs what one refresh costs; one
before costs two.

## What

One pass over `docs/wiki/`, after #305 has landed:

1. **Re-read each stale page against the code it now covers** and correct what track A actually changed —
   not a sha bump. The known behavioural deltas: the store seam (`openStore`, `src/store/{index,github,git,sqlite}.js`),
   pull requests moved to `src/forge.js`, the Actions runner and `trigger` mode removed (the
   `REMOVED_PROFILES` tombstone in `src/board.js`), the Node floor at 22.13, the `test`/`packed artifact`
   gate jobs, and `storeGitDir` vs `storeRoot`.
2. **Repoint every `covers:` path** to its `.ts` name and re-stamp `sha`/`generated_at_commit`/`last_refreshed`.
3. **New pages for what has no page**: the two local tiers already have `architecture/kb-board-branch`;
   the index tier (`src/store/sqlite.js`) and the composed store (#294) do not. AGENTS.md: new feature →
   new page.
4. Pages that describe something that no longer exists (the Actions runner path in
   `features/tracks.md`, `features/up-and-down.md`) say so or lose the section — a wiki that documents a
   removed profile is worse than one that omits it.

## Done when

- [ ] `node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` → 0 stale, 0 malformed.
- [ ] No page's prose contradicts the code it covers (spot-check each rewritten claim against the file).
- [ ] The index tier and the composed store each have a page.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green (docs-only, but the hook runs anyway).
title: The wiki is 23 pages stale after track A: one refresh pass, after the TypeScript rename
